title: Ashbury Rewards Tier Benefits: Retained Share on Late Award Cancellations
content:
Ashbury Rewards upper tiers keep more of their points when a Reward Night Rate reservation is cancelled after the deadline or ends as a no-show. The retained share of the night value — the part of one night's points value that is not returned — is set by the tier and by the elite night credits posted in the twelve months before the handling date, less the night credits reversed in those months.

## Retained share

| Tier | Net elite night credits in the twelve months | Retained share of the night value |
|---|---|---|
| Ashbury Rewards Ambassador Elite | any | 0 percent |
| Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite or Titanium Elite | 50 or more | 50 percent |
| Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite or Titanium Elite | 49 or fewer | No different share under this table |
| Member, Silver Elite or Gold Elite | any | No different share under this table |

In words: a member at Ashbury Rewards Ambassador Elite has a retained share of zero percent; a member at Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite or Titanium Elite with at least fifty such night credits has a retained share of fifty percent.

## The twelve months

The twelve months before the handling date are the transactions posted after the same day number twelve months earlier, up to and including the handling date. The net figure is the night credits posted in that window less the night credits reversed in it, every kind of night credit included.

## Cases (hypothetical members)

| Tier | Night credits posted in the window | Reversed in the window | Net | Retained share |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Titanium Elite | 52 | 3 | 49 | No different share |
| Titanium Elite | 53 | 3 | 50 | 50 percent |
| Platinum Elite | 61 | 0 | 61 | 50 percent |
| Ambassador Elite | 4 | 0 | 4 | 0 percent |
